images.name: 余烬·断岳
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original fantasy game weapon concept illustration for a Skyrim SE mod, ONE complete two-handed GREATSWORD in a portrait image.
Art direction: a massive weapon built from simple, thick, clean geometric volumes of solid magical light. Strong sculptural silhouette, substantial blade width and thickness, crisp planar bevels, readable negative spaces, a practical long two-hand grip. The surface is smooth luminous energy, NOT metal, stone, ice or textured crystal. Darker saturated planes, brighter luminous cut edges, restrained local bloom that preserves every contour; a few small matching particles close to the blade. Sophisticated polished game concept rendering, subtle three-quarter angle showing thickness, almost straight-on for clear modelling reference.
Composition: entire single sword floats vertically, point UP, pommel DOWN, all parts fully visible with generous margins, centered on a plain nearly black charcoal backdrop. Blade roughly 70 percent of total length, functional two-hand grip roughly 23 percent. The handle must physically connect to the blade through an unobstructed grip and guard. No person, no hand, no scenery, no extra weapons, no inset panels, no text, no logos, no watermarks. NO six-pointed star, no runic writing, no gold trim, no giant aura that hides geometry, no wispy wire-thin blade. Make an original striking design, not a copy of an existing franchise weapon.
Unique design: THE MOUNTAIN CLEAVER. Scarlet and deep crimson with small rose highlights. An exceptionally wide rectangular executioner greatsword, confidently brutal and architectural: nearly parallel thick cutting edges, a chisel-like angular spear point, one stepped shoulder near the guard. A strong central longitudinal spine and three large graduated triangular windows in the broad blade lower half, with intact thick load-bearing bridges. The outer cutting silhouette stays continuous and intimidating. Guard is a broad short inverted trapezoid of red solid light, two angular downward swept knuckles, a compact faceted rectangular pommel. Two-handed rectangular softly beveled grip with only three sparse inset seams. Several tiny red triangular ember chips drift near the blade tip. Large simple forms, exceptional visual clarity.

A continuous very broad gently sweeping crescent blade with an outward hooked angular point and a thick faceted back edge. The lower back edge has two purposeful long oblique triangular cutouts, leaving a bold curved cutting edge and strong central web. Design should feel fluid, fast and distinctly different from a rectangular cleaver.

Unique design: THE SUSPENDED CROWN. Royal violet and deep indigo planes, lavender to pink-violet luminous accents. A regal broad double-edged greatsword with a continuous tapered diamond/leaf-shaped blade, a pronounced raised central rhombus spine, and two restrained symmetric steps near the blade root. The blade must be a broad solid planar surface, not an open rail sword. Distinctive guard: a thick open hexagonal crown-like collar framing the LOWER BLADE ROOT, with an open top and three simple upward faceted prongs; two short swept wings form the crossguard. The polygonal collar is attached structurally at the guard sides and sits around the blade base, leaving the long hand grip clear below. One small suspended luminous rhombus is inset within the lower blade root above the grip, no spherical gem. Long elegant two-hand grip, flattened diamond pommel. Sparse small lavender diamond particles close to the crown. Noble and arcane, bold simple geometry, no filigree, no circular huge magic sigil.
